data.title: Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Meets with UK Minister of State for Trade
data.content:
London, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Cabinet Member, Climate Envoy, and Commissioner General of Expo 2030 Riyadh Adel Al-Jubeir, on an official visit to the United Kingdom, met today with UK Minister of State for Trade at the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Anas Sarwar.
    During the meeting, they reviewed the longstanding relations between the two countries, discussed ways to strengthen bilateral ties to serve their mutual interests, and addressed ongoing preparations to host Expo 2030 Riyadh.
    The meeting was attended by Saudi Ambassador to the United Kingdom Prince Abdullah bin Khalid bin Sultan bin Abdulaziz.
    -- SPA
